verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly ship a built-in AI coding agent in its terminal, so this axis applies. The pack shows no such capability. Copilot is documented only inside Office apps. The Windows AI Foundry toolkit and Windows AI APIs are developer building blocks, and PowerShell is a CLI with no AI-agent functionality described.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use built-in AI coding agents directly in the terminal to write and run code
